scope: Offline tests against the implemented Python service. External Trello and Calendar calls are mocked. These checks do not measure live service uptime.
checks: access requires sender and private or allowlisted chat
date only is local end of day

examples.title: A complete request
examples.input: Schedule the weekly review on 15 October 2026, 14:00 to 14:30, Berlin time.
examples.detail: The confirmed date and duration produce 2026-10-15T14:00:00+02:00. External writes are mocked in this example.
examples.decision: AI interprets the request; explicit validation controls whether an action is allowed.

examples.title: Missing information
examples.input: Schedule the weekly review on 15 October at 14:00.
examples.plan: Create event · start confirmed · end missing
examples.detail: The service validator returns: Ask for event duration or end time. The workflow needs an end time before a calendar write can proceed.
examples.decision: Do not invent a meeting duration to make the workflow appear successful.

examples.title: Recover an interrupted write
examples.input: A Trello create operation is retried after an interrupted response.
examples.plan: Check the persistent marker before another create
examples.result: Existing card recovered; no second create call
examples.detail: The test supplies an existing card through a mocked lookup. The integration reuses it and makes no POST to create another card.
examples.decision: Recover earlier work before retrying, so an uncertain response does not become a duplicate task.
